content: Original test passes; my changes break it. Old code works despite ClassDocumenter.get_doc (line 1377) returning List[str] while DocstringSignatureMixin._find_signature expects List[List[str]]. MRO: ClassDocumenter → DocstringSignatureMixin → ModuleLevelDocumenter → Documenter. DocstringSignatureMixin.get_doc (line 1079) checks _new_docstrings; if None calls super().get_doc() → ModuleLevelDocumenter.get_doc → Documenter.get_doc, which returns List[List[str]]. But self.get_doc() inside _find_signature resolves to ClassDocumenter.get_doc (more derived, MRO priority), returning List[str]. With original code, doclines[0] is first char, no regex match, _find_signature returns None, DocstringSignatureMixin.format_signature calls super().format_signature() (next in MRO: ModuleLevelDocumenter → Documenter.format_signature), where self.args is None so it introspects via _call_format_args; test still expects docstring-based (a1, a2, kw1=True, kw2=False), so introspection path unlikely to produce that.
